jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
As a People Business Partner at Sage, you work alongside the leaders who move the business forward, helping them build stronger teams, steer through change, and turn ambitious plans into results that hold up. You bring a clear point of view, a steady presence, and the kind of judgment leaders come to rely on. You tend to see what is coming before it arrives, and you are usually already thinking about what to do about it.

What You Will Own

Leading change that sticks. Guiding transformation, workforce planning, restructuring, and cross-functional projects with clear goals, visible sponsorship, disciplined communication, collaborator alignment, and enough structure to keep the right people moving together without slowing the work down.
Being the voice leaders rely on. Partnering with senior leaders as they set direction, offering clear guidance, candid input, and the kind of decision-focused meeting leadership that helps teams align quickly and leave with shared ownership of next steps.
Building teams that perform. Shaping talent, performance, engagement, and organizational design so people do their best work, teams pull in the same direction, and the business can grow without losing its footing.
Letting the evidence lead. Turning people metrics, patterns, and trends into choices you can defend, outcomes you can measure, and practical answers leaders can act on.
Solving the problems that do not come with a playbook. Spotting risk, gaps, and openings early, asking better questions, testing practical options, and bringing creative, sound answers before small issues grow into large ones.
Connecting the wider system. Working hand in hand with global P&C teams and Centers of Excellence while navigating complex employee relations, performance, and compliance matters toward outcomes that are fair, sound, scalable, and right for the business.

You will thrive here if

You meet leaders where they are. No two leaders are alike, and you adjust your approach to their style, context, pressure points, and readiness without losing your authenticity or lowering the bar.
You can translate without diluting. You know how to turn people strategy, policy, data, and change into language that makes sense to the leader in front of you, whether they need the headline, the risk, the options, or the next practical step.
You say what needs saying in a way it can be heard. You give leaders the straight version, even when an easier answer is sitting right there, and you know when to challenge, when to coach, and when to create space for them to get there.
You trust your own read. You are comfortable taking a position and standing behind it, and you bring original thinking instead of reaching for the default playbook.
You know the edge of what you know. When you are not certain, you say so and go find the answer, because getting it right matters more to you than appearing to have it all figured out.
You move with the business. Fast pace, shifting ground, more questions than answers? That tends to be where you do some of your best work, because you can bring enough structure, judgment, and calm to help leaders keep moving.

What You Bring

Strategic Influence and Change Leadership

A track record of becoming the trusted voice behind business leaders in complex or global organizations.
Real experience guiding transformation and change, not just watching it happen around you.
A practical change-management toolkit: clear case for change, stakeholder mapping, sponsor alignment, communication cadence, manager enablement, adoption tracking, and reinforcement after launch.
The ability to shape thinking and direction at senior levels through influence rather than authority.

Business and People Expertise

Deep command of modern people practices, including organizational design, talent strategy, and workforce planning.
A history of translating business strategy into results-driven people plans.
Sound judgment in employee relations and the complex, human realities of organizational life.

Data and Insight

Genuine comfort with data, and the skill to turn it into recommendations people can act on.
Experience using metrics to prove what is working and improve what is not.

Project Management and Meeting Leadership

The ability to organize complex work into clear plans, owners, achievements, and follow-through that keep projects moving.
Confidence leading meetings that have purpose, pace, and outcomes, especially when the room includes senior leaders or competing points of view.
Strong facilitation skills that help groups focus, make decisions, resolve ambiguity, and leave knowing what happens next.

Agility and Execution

A calm, solution-first approach when priorities shift and the ground keeps moving.
The ability to hold competing demands and still deliver with both quality and pace.
Creative problem solving that combines curiosity, data, business context, and good judgment to move from ambiguity to a workable path forward.
A naturally collaborative style that connects easily across teams and geographies.

Leadership and Trust

Communication that engages, earns trust, and works at every level of the organization.
Emotional intelligence and balanced judgment, especially when the pressure is on.
A real commitment to inclusive practice and to building a culture of accountability, performance, and belonging.

If you read this and thought, “that is the job I have been waiting for”, we wish to hear from you!

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact hr.resume@sagepub.com
All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with Sage covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. We strive to achieve a better representation of diverse talent at all levels, including leadership, across our workforce.

jobs.title: Principal HR Business Partner - Tech
jobs.description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About The Role

As Hims & Hers continues to scale, the complexity of our business, leaders, and organization continues to grow. We're looking for a Principal HR Business Partner to help shape what's next.

This is a highly strategic role that requires exceptional business acumen as much as HR expertise. The right person will develop a deep understanding of our business, operating model, and leadership priorities, then translate that understanding into building organizations, leadership teams, and talent strategies that enable the business to move faster and scale effectively.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping shape not only organizational decisions, but how leaders think about organization, leadership, and talent. You'll bring an independent point of view, challenge assumptions, connect patterns others don't see, and help leaders navigate the moments that matter most.

This role is equally about solving today's challenges and building the organizational capability needed for tomorrow. Success isn't defined by the number of decisions you support. It's defined by the quality of the organizations, leaders, and operating models you help build.

You Will

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping shape business strategy through organization design, leadership, and talent.
Lead organization design, workforce planning, and succession efforts that position the business for its next stage of growth.
Partner with leaders to design organizations that create clear ownership, accelerate decision making, and enable teams to scale.
Coach senior leaders through organizational change, leadership transitions, performance challenges, and other high-impact business moments.
Bring a clear, well-reasoned point of view to complex organizational decisions, helping leaders evaluate tradeoffs and move forward with confidence.
Identify emerging organizational risks and opportunities by connecting themes across leaders, teams, and the broader business before they become barriers to execution.
Build practical, scalable approaches that improve how leaders lead, how teams operate, and how the organization grows over time.
Partner closely with Recruiting, Compensation, Employment Legal, HR Operations, and other People leaders to ensure business decisions are supported with thoughtful, integrated People strategies.
Raise the standard for HR partnership by modeling exceptional business thinking, organizational insight, and leadership influence while helping develop other HRBPs across the team.
Master, own, and interpret People programs (e.g., Compensation, Legal, Performance) to provide authoritative guidance to the business, knowing that strategic partnership at this level is built on a foundation of operational excellence.

You Have

12+ years of progressive HR experience, including senior HRBP partnership in operational or complex environments
Significant experience partnering with senior business leaders in complex, high-growth organizations.
Demonstrated success leading organization design, workforce planning, leadership development, and talent strategy.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex business challenges into practical organizational solutions.
Proven ability to influence executive leaders through credibility, thoughtful challenge, and a clear point of view.
Experience helping organizations navigate growth, transformation, and organizational change.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate organizational issues, connect patterns across the business, and proactively solve problems before they slow the organization down.
Strong executive presence with the confidence to coach leaders, challenge assumptions, and influence important business decisions.
A builder's mindset with a track record of creating scalable approaches that improve how organizations operate over time.
Ability to move seamlessly between long-term strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We're committed to building a team that reflects diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe different ways of thinking make us stronger, and we're dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to do their best work.

Gaggle is a leading technology company dedicated to enhancing student safety and wellness in K-12 schools. Our innovative solutions enable school districts to identify concerns early, allowing for timely interventions that can save lives. We are committed to creating a safer and healthier learning environment through cutting-edge technology and dedicated support. We are seeking a detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to join our dynamic team. This hands-on role is pivotal in managing day-to-day HR operations, including leave administration, onboarding and offboarding processes, compliance documentation, and employee and contractor support. The ideal candidate will thrive in a structured environment, possess excellent organizational skills, and have a passion for ensuring HR processes run smoothly. 5+ years of professional work experience, including at least 2 years in HR with multi-state exposure
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
Working knowledge of federal and multi-state employment laws and fundamentals
Strong organizational and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail
Experience navigating complex HRIS platforms such as Paychex

Administer Gaggle's in-house leave program, including tracking usage, documentation, and approvals/denials
Track and apply state-specific paid leave programs, escalating questions as needed
Communicate promptly with HR and Finance regarding all leave needs
Maintain documentation for ADA interactive process and compliance requirements

Manage background check workflows and related administration
Support recruiting efforts, including managing job postings and responding to candidate inquiries
Maintain a comprehensive list of state registrations, powers of attorney, and system logins
Respond to employment verification requests efficiently
Assist with annual handbook review and compliance initiatives

Assist with the annual performance review process and routine HR administrative tasks
Generate HR reports, including custom reports, from HRIS platforms as needed
Track employee status changes for accurate recordkeeping
Provide administrative support to HR and Finance teams, including vendor coordination and event logistics
Cross-train on core HR processes to ensure team continuity
Serve as a first point of contact for employee questions or concerns, maintaining confidentiality and professionalism

Immediate vesting 401(k) plan with a 4% company contribution with each paycheck

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a People Ops Coordinator based in the United States.

This role is central to building a smooth, reliable employee experience in a growing remote-first organization.

You’ll own key People Operations processes across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and benefits coordination to records and offboarding.

You’ll also support recruiting, performance initiatives, employee engagement, and internal culture programs.

Beyond People Operations, you’ll provide coordination support to senior leaders and help move important cross-functional projects forward.

The role is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing structure to evolving environments and improving processes as a company scales.

You’ll work closely with colleagues across the organization while handling sensitive information with discretion, care, and sound judgment.

This is an opportunity to have broad operational impact while developing your career alongside experienced leaders in an early-stage environment.

Accountabilities

Own day-to-day People Operations activities throughout the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, benefits and payroll coordination, HRIS updates, PTO tracking, and employee records.
Serve as an approachable first point of contact for routine employee questions, escalating sensitive or complex matters appropriately.
Support performance management, employee engagement, feedback cycles, goal-setting, recognition programs, and team-building initiatives.
Coordinate recruiting and hiring activities end to end, including job descriptions, interview scheduling, candidate communications, recruiting documentation, and the transition from candidate to new hire.
Provide coordination and administrative support to senior leaders and assist with cross-functional projects from initial request through completion.
Build, document, simplify, and improve People and operational processes as the organization grows.
Identify opportunities to automate workflows and reduce administrative friction across People Operations and broader company operations.
Maintain strong follow-through across multiple priorities while ensuring a consistent, organized, and high-quality employee experience.

Requirements

1–3 years of experience in People Operations, Human Resources, or a related administrative or business operations role.
Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues at different levels of the organization.
High degree of discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive employee information.
Proactive and resourceful approach, with the confidence to take ownership and move work forward without requiring detailed instructions.
Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities, processes, and responsibilities can evolve quickly.
Strong follow-through and a bias toward action, with a genuine interest in making processes more efficient and reliable.
Familiarity with HR, project management, collaboration, HRIS, or other business operations tools.
Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours; candidates based in Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones are preferred.

Benefits

Fully remote work with the flexibility to work from anywhere while maintaining U.S. business hours.
Competitive compensation package, including participation in an equity program.
Mentorship and exposure to experienced executives and senior leaders.
Opportunity to take meaningful ownership and make a direct impact within a rapidly growing startup.
Broad exposure to People Operations, recruiting, company operations, and cross-functional initiatives.
Opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility within an early-stage environment.
Travel opportunities for in-person team off-sites, subject to visa and travel eligibility.

About Edra

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. The Role

Edra is 30+ people across New York and London, with aggressive hiring plans in both offices. Every one of those people runs through an offer, payroll in one of two countries, equity in one of two tax regimes, benefits, and the compliance layer underneath it all. We've laid the foundation; now we want someone to own it, and to build the version that gets us to 60, 100, and beyond.

You'll own the employee lifecycle end to end in both countries: US and UK payroll, benefits in both regimes, onboarding, and people compliance across two jurisdictions. At most companies, people ops is carved into slices; here you own the whole stack, with real autonomy to determine how it runs. You'll own these systems internally, working directly with our payroll providers, benefits brokers, accountants, and employment counsel where specialist expertise is needed.

That's the exciting part, so we'll be specific about it: this is a builder and operator role. You'll inherit working processes and be expected to replace each one as we outgrow it: automating what's manual, rebuilding for scale, and designing the systems a much larger Edra will still be running down the line. And because we're an AI company, we expect you to build like one. Edra's platform is available to you as a tool for your own function, and we want you using it (along with everything else in a modern AI startup stack) to build and run a people operation that's leaner, faster, and more precise than a traditional people operation. If you've ever looked at a payroll reconciliation or an onboarding checklist and thought “a system should be doing this!” this is the place to prove it.

One thing to be upfront about: comp philosophy, equity strategy, and performance management remain Founder-owned. You'll make those programs operationally excellent: the data, tooling, process, communication, and execution behind them.

What You'll Do

Be the first point of contact for operational people questions (payroll, benefits, leave, equity administration, and employment logistics) and resolve them quickly and clearly.
Own US and UK payroll end to end: run it, reconcile it, handle joiners and leavers, catch problems before they reach a paycheck, and fix the ones that do fast.
Design and build our onboarding program from first principles, so new hires are set up to take ownership and have impact from day one, in either office.
Automate onboarding and offboarding processes across both entities: equipment and access provisioning, benefits enrollment, compliance training, and more.
Administer benefits in both countries: US healthcare and 401(k), including open enrollment and renewals; UK pension and benefits.
Own the operational compliance calendar across both countries, including required payroll, benefits, employment, and personnel processes and filings.
Keep Rippling accurate as the source of record for headcount, comp, and org data, and extend it wherever it can take work off a human
Build automations and internal tooling for repetitive people workflows, using Edra’s own platform and other AI tools wherever they can improve speed, accuracy, or employee experience.

What We’re Looking For

You've owned significant parts of people operations at a startup through a growth phase. You've personally processed payroll, fixed benefits enrollment errors, and onboarded new team members, not just managed vendors who did.
You've worked across US and UK employment infrastructure, or have international people ops experience and can close the gap quickly.
You default to systems. When something breaks twice, you fix the process, and when a task is repetitive, you automate it rather than staffing it.
You're curious about what AI tooling can do for an operations function, and you'd rather experiment and find out than wait for a vendor to tell you.
You're detail-oriented at the level this work requires. Errors in payroll and benefits are visible to everyone—you make sure they don’t happen.
You write clearly, especially when explaining equity, benefits, and policy to people who aren't specialists.
You handle confidential comp and performance information with discretion.

UK payroll and pensions depth
Experience standing up new benefits programs in the US and UK
Fluency with Rippling
Track record of building automation or tooling inside an ops function
